model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of different knowledge editing methods on a dataset across various co-occurrence number groups. The x-axis represents the co-occurrence number groups, labeled as "<10^1", "[10^1,10^2)", "[10^2,10^3)", and "≥10^3", with no units and a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled as "Locality (%)", with a linear scale, ranging from 55 to 65, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot contains six lines, each representing a different knowledge editing method: "ROME" (green, solid line, square markers), "MEMIT" (purple, dashed line, triangle markers), "MEND" (red, dashed line, circle markers), "IKE" (blue, dashed line, diamond markers), "FT" (orange, dashed line, star markers), and "Base" (black, solid line, no markers). The "ROME" line starts at approximately 83.70 and ends at around 84.45, showing a steady increase. The "MEMIT" line begins at about 83.70 and ends at roughly 97.23, exhibiting a significant increase. The "MEND" line starts at approximately 96.00 and ends at around 97.23, displaying a slight increase. The "IKE" line begins at about 97.81 and ends at roughly 96.87, showing a slight decrease. The "FT" line starts at approximately 96.80 and ends at around 97.57, remaining relatively steady. The "Base" line is not visible in the plot.
